about_the_game:
Endor Awakens: Dungeon Crawler is a thrilling evolution of Depths of Endor, where chaos reigns in the changing world after the fall of Mordoth. In this Dungeon Crawler, you'll venture through procedurally generated dungeons, encountering new challenges and treasures with every step.

The city has transformed with new features:

  • Shop: Buy weapons and armor to prepare for your adventures.

  • Inn: Meet new NPCs, take on common quests, and delve into the main story and side adventures.

  • Guilds: Unlock skills via a new skill tree and customize your character to match your playstyle.

  • Bestiary: Track the monsters you've faced and defeated.

  • Bank: Store items you don't need for later use.

  • Daily Chest: Log in every day for rewards and bonuses.

  • Morgue: Resurrect fallen heroes and continue your journey.

Create your characters by choosing their race, gender, guild, and portrait. Hardcore mode adds extra challenge: if your character dies, there's no coming back. Pick a custom avatar from your device's gallery to make your hero truly unique.

Turn-based combat allows you to strategize every move, whether it's attacking, casting spells, using items, or defending. Beware of traps and events as you explore the depths of dungeons.

Endor Awakens offers endless possibilities for adventure, as you forge your path through this ever-changing world. Your choices shape your journey, with each dungeon and character offering new opportunities. Will you rise to defeat the chaos, or succumb to the darkness of the depths? The fate of Endor lies in your hands.
